HOW TO SURVIVE

MOVEMENT

WASD move · Shift sprint · Ctrl crouch · Space vault

COMBAT

LMB fire · RMB aim · R reload · 1/2 weapons · G frag grenade

GEAR

F flashlight · E revive partner / pick up supplies

THE JOB

Clear each wave of infected. Headshots hurt them most. Between waves, grab the supply drops in the atrium and keep Rook on his feet.

THE PARTNER

Rook draws fire and calls out threats. If he goes down, get close and hold E. Neither of you makes it out alone.

THE MALL

Flickering lights, narrow storefronts, a lot of things that used to be shoppers. Watch the escalators and the cinema doors.

Press ESC to pause during a run.
